Samira Khan: Quick plan: small 'Thank-a-Manager' kit + spot-award vouchers during the mid-May recognition window. Need shipping list and payroll timing.
Riley Thompson: Sounds good. What's the kit and per-unit budget?
Samira Khan: Branded pen, snack, card, $40 voucher. ~ $48/kit after shipping.
Diego Alvarez: I can handle vendor upload and labels. Send CSV by Wed.
People Ops Bot: New RSVP form: https://forms.redwood-internal/manager-kit. Deadline Tue 10am.
Samira Khan: Payroll note: to include stipend in May payroll, approvals & code assignment must be done by 2027-05-10 23:59 PST.
PayrollBot: Reminder: payroll cutoff 2027-05-10 23:59 PST for one-time stipends.
Riley Thompson: Confirm contractors who managed people are included. Also PO box rule?
Samira Khan: Include contractors; vendor cannot ship to PO boxes. Flag any PO boxes.
Diego Alvarez: CSV template: `name,email,address_line1,address_line2,city,state,zip,country,notes`. Will normalize country to US/CA/UK.
Samira Khan: Action items: Riley exports managers list (Tue 9am), Diego prepares CSV & uploads (Tue 3pm), Samira mints voucher codes and coordinates with Payroll (Tue EOD).
Riley Thompson: I'll scrub PII and post secure file in #people-ops-sec.
Samira Khan: Good. Also small all-hands blurb? 1 line.
Diego Alvarez: I'll draft blurb and share in #all-hands-drafts.
Samira Khan: Thanks everyone — will post final manifest once codes are created. :sparkles:
